texts.en: The Colonial Institute contains books and papers concerning British colonies. It is open to the public but they refuse to let in a group of street children. An arch runs from an upper-storey window of the Institute to an open window of the theatre across the road. A kitchen girl is throwing out food waste. “The window keys are kept in the staff office,” she tells us. “I can use ’em if I so please, as can any of them that work here – footmen, librarians, and wardens.” As we leave, we see two maids carrying bags of uniforms away down the street, presumably to get them cleaned.
